verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows general BVNK payment/payout/wallet APIs (bvnk-docs-4,11,24,26) and Hawk auth, but nothing documents an agent-specific spend-control model, scoped authority, or agent-initiated payout flow configured by a human. The only hint, a bare repo title 'agent-wallet-cli' (bvnk-probe-2), has no accompanying documentation of scoped authority or spend limits, so it cannot establish the capability.
